title: Quality Assurance Specialist
description: Lead day-to-day quality assurance execution across our manufacturing campus and support a documentation culture that meets global pharmaceutical expectations.
responsibilities: Review batch manufacturing records and supporting GMP documentation.
Coordinate deviation tracking, CAPA follow-up, and internal quality reporting.
Partner with production and validation teams on release-readiness checks.
Support inspection preparation and continuous improvement initiatives.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy, Chemistry, Microbiology, or related field.
2+ years of quality assurance experience in a GMP-regulated environment.
Strong understanding of SOP control, deviations, and CAPA workflows.
Clear written communication and disciplined documentation habits.

title: Production Pharmacist
description: Oversee production line discipline, batch execution, and safe manufacturing practices while helping scale reliable medicine output across multiple dosage formats.
responsibilities: Supervise daily production activities and enforce schedule adherence.
Verify line clearance, process parameters, and in-process documentation.
Coordinate with quality and engineering teams to resolve production issues.
Champion training and compliance for manufacturing operators.
requirements: Registered pharmacist or equivalent academic qualification.
Experience in oral solid dosage or general pharmaceutical manufacturing.
Working knowledge of GMP, safety, and process controls.
Ability to manage cross-functional coordination under production timelines.

title: R&D Analytical Analyst
description: Support product development and method verification with disciplined analytical work, technical reporting, and close collaboration across R&D and quality functions.
responsibilities: Execute analytical testing for formulation development and stability studies.
Maintain lab documentation, raw data integrity, and sample traceability.
Assist in method transfer and troubleshooting for development programs.
Prepare concise technical summaries for internal review.
requirements: Degree in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Science, or a related discipline.
Hands-on experience with HPLC, UV, dissolution, or similar techniques.
Comfort working within structured lab documentation systems.
Strong attention to accuracy and scientific detail.

title: Regulatory Affairs Intern
description: Join the regulatory team to learn submission workflows, dossier organization, and the operational detail behind compliant market access in the pharmaceutical sector.
responsibilities: Assist with document preparation and submission trackers.
Support product registration file organization and version control.
Compile reference materials for regulatory response packages.
Help maintain clean administrative records across active projects.
requirements: Current undergraduate in Pharmacy, Science, or a related discipline.
Strong organizational skills and confidence with structured documentation.
Clear written English and attention to detail.
Interest in pharmaceutical compliance and market authorization work.
